nodes.label: NEST Brand Logo
nodes.description: Bold wordmark logo displaying 'NEST' in dark forest green (#2D6A35 approx) uppercase sans-serif typography. The letter 'E' is stylized with three horizontal stacked bars, suggesting layering or nesting. White background. Clean, modern brand identity.
design_elements: stylized E with horizontal stacked bars

nodes.label: Dark Forest Green — NEST Brand Color
nodes.description: Primary brand color used in the NEST logo: a dark forest green, approximately #2D6A35. Conveys trust, nature, stability.

nodes.label: Stylized E Letterform — Stacked Bars
nodes.description: The letter 'E' in the NEST logo is rendered as three horizontal parallel bars, creating a distinctive stacked/layered visual motif that reinforces the 'nesting' concept of the brand name.
